name: Ripgrep
description: Fast, bounded, read-only local content search and file discovery with ripgrep. Prefer over shell rg/grep/find for filesystem search.

search.description: Search local file contents using ripgrep; return matching lines, 1-based line numbers, paths and byte-offset submatches.
search.progressive_guidance: Choose files when only filenames are needed; rg stops after the first match in each file. Choose count for totals without collecting lines. Match records contain path, lines, line_number, absolute_offset and submatches. No multiline matching; recursively encountered binary content is skipped.

pattern.description: Literal text by default. Set options.regex=true for a Rust regex. Passed as data, never shell code.

paths.description: Existing local file/directory paths. Prefer absolute paths; relative paths resolve against the tool process working directory.

globs.description: Include/exclude rg globs, e.g. *.ts or !vendor/**. Explicit include globs override ignore rules.

hidden.description: Include hidden files and directories. Default false.

noIgnore.description: Disable ignore rules. Default false; use only for an explicitly requested scope.

ignoreCase.description: Ignore case in file filters and content matching. Default false for search, true for listFiles.

regex.description: Interpret pattern as a Rust regex. Default false (literal text).

resultMode.description: Default matches: lines with locations. files: each matching file once. count: total matching lines, not occurrences.

listFiles.description: List local files using ripgrep, optionally filtered by include/exclude globs. Filenames including newlines are preserved.
listFiles.progressive_guidance: Enumerate file paths without reading contents. Case-insensitive globs include uppercase extensions. Filenames containing newlines or non-UTF-8 bytes are preserved. files is only an inline preview; summary counts the saved inventory. Use system_utilities.tool_executions.read with jq to count, group or filter the full inventory without rescanning. Check summary.complete before treating counts as totals.

hidden.description: Include hidden files and directories. Default false.

noIgnore.description: Disable ignore rules. Default false; use only for an explicitly requested scope.

ignoreCase.description: Ignore case in file filters and content matching. Default false for search, true for listFiles.

progressive_guidance: Uses Leon-managed upstream rg. Searches are read-only and shell-free, skip recursive symlinks, and respect hidden/ignore rules unless requested otherwise. Include globs override ignore rules. Literal content matching is the default; set regex for Rust regex syntax. Filename discovery ignores case by default. Uses automatic threading without sorting. File and match inventories stream to session storage; files/matches contain only a small inline preview. preview.truncated means more saved records are available through system_utilities.tool_executions.read with the same .result.files/.result.matches jq paths; do not rescan for counts or groups. A storage/record limit or timeout sets truncated=true and summary.complete=false; counts are exact only when complete. Text uses {text} or base64 {bytes} for non-UTF-8 data.
